body:
I took two(2) 30mg pills around 5 pm. This marked my first experience using this particular substance. I didn't notice any effects for an hour or two.
Around seven-thirty, I noticed that I was being very talkative, and felt nervous or anxious for no reason. My heart was pounding, and I had that feeling that I used to get as a child when I knew I was going to get in trouble for something. Basically, the effects throughout that night remained steady until around midnight, and were as follows:
Anxiety
Heart Palpitations
Extroversion
Energy/alertness
Erectile Dysfunction
Dry Mouth
Nothing too severe, pretty moderate dose, but I don't know if I like this as an experience. Maybe someday I'll try again.
